Matte ceramic and fine satin surfaces, subtle natural texture, softly rounded details, broad soft studio light, gentle grounded contact shadows. Three-quarter view slightly from above; grouped compactly in a landscape 4:3 composition with clean silhouette and generous breathing room around every side. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, no backdrop plane, no badge, no circle outline, no enclosure, no text, names, statistics, numerals, logos, phones, screens, confetti, glow or extra floating decoration. These are fictional sculptural figures representing community, not actual Deviny members.
processing: Proportional resize and WebP export; original alpha preserved. No artwork repainting or background removal.
